results.title: The Wonderful World of Disney: Holiday Spectacular
results.original_title: The Wonderful World of Disney: Holiday Spectacular
results.overview: Hosted by Derek Hough, "The Wonderful World of Disney: Holiday Spectacular" returns for its 10th year, featuring dazzling new musical performances from Walt Disney World Resort in Florida, Disneyland Resort in California and Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa in Ko Olina, Hawaiʻi. Narrated by Ginnifer Goodwin (voice of Judy Hopps in "Zootopia 2"), who carries on the tradition of sharing how the Disney Parks sparkle to life for the holidays, "The Wonderful World of Disney: Holiday Spectacular" airs MONDAY, DEC. 1, at 8:00 p.m. EST/PST on ABC, and streams next day on Hulu and Disney+.

results.title: Emilia
results.overview: Emilia experiences her childhood through her senses. Until now, her body has been a vehicle for pleasure and curiosity. With the onset of puberty, she grows her first facial hair, and with it come concerns about her appearance. Suddenly, her body is filled with nothing but pain and shame.

results.title: Lord Help My Poor Soul
results.overview: When nearing the end of his battle with cancer, a deformed man experiments with LSD in search of enlightenment. The resulting trip takes him on a harrowing descent into an acid-drenched hell.

results.title: Blue Heart
results.overview: Marianne and Pétion live in Haiti and wait impatiently for a call from their son in the USA. The promise of the American dream now seems to elude them, as the line between hope and reality becomes increasingly blurred.

results.title: Matèl
results.overview: A young man living a monotonous life finds his boredom interrupted when he encounters a group of boys while working at a pedalo rental place.

results.title: Krone 2025
results.overview: Krone 2025 is one of South Africa’s biggest Afrikaans live music events, known for its large-scale production, mass sing‑along atmosphere, and star‑studded lineup of local artists.

results.title: Someday again
results.overview: Isabella lives for and because of her ailing father, Gabriel, but something has been tormenting her lately. As Isabella tries to stick to her routine, strange things begin to happen — yet she’s not ready to find out what it is.

results.title: We Beat the Dream Team
results.overview: Discover the little-known story of a group of college basketball players who were tasked with preparing Larry Bird, Magic Johnson, and Michael Jordan and the rest of the legendary "Dream Team" for their Olympic debut in 1992.

results.title: Ucronia
results.overview: A man wrestles with his personal demons and obsession with a writer's life.

results.title: iHeartRadio Jingle Ball 2025
results.overview: The annual holiday music celebration returns, featuring leading artists and celebrity guests coming together to spread festive joy.

results.title: Cat Rong Po
results.overview: Liu Liu is living in a strange new land. While his mother looks after the shop, he goes exploring. Encountering a ghost monster, a fierce battle begins.  Behind the shop counter, Liu Liu’s mother listens to audiotapes to teach herself Hungarian. Bored and frustrated, Liu Liu goes in search of adventure. Exploring this new and foreign land, he encounters a mysterious monster.

results.title: Creatures of the Mind
results.overview: Sidarta Ribeiro, a Brazilian neuroscientist, explores how dreams and other forms of access to the unconscious can transform human experience. In his research, he proposes combining the ancestral knowledge of indigenous peoples and people of African origin in Brazil with scientific knowledge, as well as a scientific reevaluation of experiences with hallucinogens.

results.title: the Atheist
results.overview: The events deal with the idea of ​​religious extremism and atheism affecting young people and its impact on society. A tense dramatic thriller about a respected public figure whose private doubts trigger a chain of events that shake his family and community. As secrets surface, the film explores belief, identity, and the cost of truth in a tightly-knit society.

results.title: Redneck Mutants
results.overview: Husband and wife parapsychologists Lee and Claire Marshall nearly crash their car in the woods after barely avoiding an insectoid monster darting across the road. A search for help leads to a derelict house and its bizarre inhabitants; brothers Bart and Mart, once twins until Bart began mutating into a glowing green monster, and their "Maw", a tyrannical harridan who, due to a glitch in the time vortex, is half the age of her sons. This bizarre family hides a secret, and eliminates any strangers who threaten to uncover it. Lee and Claire's attempts to escape leads them through a "Dead Place" teeming with bizarre creatures and a final, horrifying encounter with the alien source of all these mysteries.

results.title: Big Dawg
results.overview: A desperate man runs late for a job interview set up by his arrogant brother-in-law.

results.title: French Touch
results.overview: The story that follows is that of the President of the Land of Diamonds. A fictional character, in a fictional world, yet close to reality.

results.title: Soulcatcher
results.overview: During a total solar eclipse, four girls visit a mysterious witch's house looking for a magical ritual. But something goes wrong and they find themselves trapped in a dimensional limbo where the Soulcatcher rules... And only one can get out of there alive.
